title: India just put a passenger boat on the Ganga that runs on hydrogen
sources: PIB, December 2025 - India's first indigenous hydrogen fuel cell passenger vessel flagged off at Varanasi
Marine Insight, December 2025 - India launches its first indigenous hydrogen fuel cell passenger vessel
caption:
India just put a passenger boat on the Ganga that runs on hydrogen. Built entirely in India, for India's own waterways.

India's first indigenous hydrogen fuel cell-powered passenger vessel entered commercial service on the Ganga at Varanasi, built by Cochin Shipyard for the Inland Waterways Authority of India. The 24-metre catamaran, carrying up to 50 passengers, runs on a hybrid system combining hydrogen fuel cells, batteries and solar panels, operating up to 8 hours per hydrogen fill with only water as its emission. It's positioned as part of India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.

A river that's carried boats for centuries just carried one that leaves nothing behind but water.
